name: Yumeutsutsu Re:After
source:
Yumeutsutsu Re:After includes the following character after stories:

- Kokoro After Story: “Yumeutsutsu Re:Unification”
- Saki After Story: “Deadline Rather than Paradise”
- Nana After Story: “Ghosts of the Past”
- Marie After Story: “Married Life”
- Honoka Episode: “Love Story, With Her and the Dog”
translation:
《梦现Re:After》收录了以下角色的后续故事：

- 心的后日谈：《梦现Re:Unification》
- 早希的后日谈：《Deadline Rather than Paradise》
- 奈奈的后日谈：《过去的亡灵》
- 玛丽的后日谈：《Married Life》
- 穗乃花篇：《她与狗和爱的故事》
